question: Among all the posts posted by the most influential user, identify the percentage with a score above 50.
evidence: The higher reputation the user has the more influence; percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(stats_posts.Id where Score > 50 and MAX(Reputation))), COUNT(stats_posts.Id where MAX(Reputation));
clarification: Count each distinct Id only once.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(Reputation) AS max_reputation FROM users) AS T3 ON T1.Reputation = T3.max_reputation
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users T1 INNER JOIN posts T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(Reputation) AS max_reputation FROM users ) T3 ON T1.Reputation = T3.max_reputation

c.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Score > 50 THEN p.Id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id) AS percentage FROM posts p WHERE p.OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users ORDER BY Reputation DESC LIMIT 1)

d.request: Among all the posts made by the most influential user (the user with the highest reputation), what percentage have a score above 50, counting each distinct post Id only once?
d.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Score > 50 THEN Id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT Id) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users ORDER BY Reputation DESC LIMIT 1)

b.request: Among all posts owned by the user with the highest Reputation (the most influential user), what percentage of them, counting each distinct post Id only once, have a Score greater than 50 (distinct posts with Score > 50 divided by distinct posts owned by that user, times 100)?
b.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Score > 50 THEN p.Id END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id) FROM posts p WHERE p.OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users ORDER BY Reputation DESC LIMIT 1)
